atoms.a: I will go to the cinema tomorrow.
The plants will have grown higher than the fence by next summer.
We will study together next week.
Simon will have tried his new skateboard by Saturday.
My friends will ask my mother if I can join them at their sleepover.

atoms.b: By the end of the project week they ((++will_have_learned will_learn)) many new things.
I believe I ((++won't_have_finished won't_finish)) my homework by the start of the lesson.
Sue's brothers say they ((++will_have_earned will_earn)) a million pounds by the time they are 30.
Caleb ((++will_travel will_have_travelled)) to Dublin during the summer holidays.
My parents ((++won't_buy won't_have_bought)) peanut butter anymore because my sister is allergic to peanuts.
I am sure some of us ((++won't_have_eaten won't_eat)) their lunch by the end of the break.

Also, I ((++will_have_talked ++will_talk)) to my little cousin a lot. By the time we arrive, he ((++will_have_turned will_turn)) eleven already. I guess we ((++will_play will_have_played)) video games together.
